stories.title: Trump escalates pressure on Fed Chair Warsh to cut rates as the FOMC's two-day meeting begins
stories.reason: Trump, Vance and Treasury Secretary Bessent are all publicly pushing for cuts even as markets price a 90% chance of a hike, setting up a direct test of central bank independence two months before the midterms.

stories.title: Global shares slide as oil tops $106 with the Fed and Bank of Japan both poised to raise rates this week
stories.reason: Fresh Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the East-West pipeline shutdown have crude near multi-month highs just as the BOJ weighs its own 25-basis-point hike to defend the yen, compounding pressure on markets already rattled by AI-slowdown warnings.

stories.title: India approves 18-hour daily power exports to Nepal through December as flood death toll passes 1,400
stories.reason: A glacial mountain collapse triggered floods that destroyed at least 12 Nepali hydropower plants and left 5,500 people missing, forcing a country that normally exports electricity to import it from India just to keep the lights on.

stories.title: Netflix's 'The AI Doc' premieres today, with Altman, Amodei and Hassabis confronting AI's existential stakes on camera
stories.reason: Directed by Oscar winner Daniel Roher and drawing on 40 interviews including Yoshua Bengio and Eliezer Yudkowsky, the film's release lands squarely amid this week's real-world fight over whether AI development should slow down.

stories.title: Newsom tells CNN he won't run for president in 2028 if Kamala Harris does
stories.reason: The California governor called a potential primary matchup with Harris 'mutual assured destruction,' a rare public deference between two of the Democratic Party's most prominent potential 2028 contenders.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian oil refineries overnight as both sides trade mass drone attacks
stories.reason: Kyiv hit the TANECO and Slavyansk-EKO refineries deep inside Russia hours after Moscow launched hundreds of drones at western Ukraine, underscoring how both sides are increasingly targeting energy infrastructure far from the front line.

stories.title: India's wholesale inflation surges to 9.92% in August as food, fuel and manufacturing costs climb
stories.reason: The jump from July's 9.78% shows how global energy price pressure from the Iran war and Red Sea disruptions is now feeding directly into one of the world's largest emerging economies.

stories.title: UN reports sharp escalation in Israeli military activity along Lebanon's Blue Line, with over 4,000 war deaths to date
stories.reason: Peacekeepers recorded 84 Israeli projectiles fired in a single day in early September despite a June ceasefire framework, as the death toll from the year-long Lebanon war passes 4,000 and displacement tops a million people.
